query:
SELECT
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'income'  THEN base_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "income!: Decimal",
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'expense' THEN base_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "expense!: Decimal",
                COUNT(*) AS "count!"
               FROM transactions
               WHERE ledger_id = $1
                 AND type IN ('income', 'expense')
                 AND occurred_at >= $2
                 AND occurred_at <= $3
